idea-plugin.name: ClickHouse Console
idea-plugin.description:
Run ClickHouse queries straight from your IDE and read the result as a table — no external client, no copy-paste of results.

  • Official HTTP interface: the plugin talks to the ClickHouse HTTP interface (port 8123 by default). It is the same interface the clickhouse-client uses over HTTP, with the official X-ClickHouse-User / X-ClickHouse-Key headers.
  • Any IDE: the plugin only needs the IntelliJ Platform, so it works in IDEA Community, PyCharm Community, WebStorm, GoLand and the others — including the IDEs where the built-in database tools are not available.
  • Result as a table: columns and types come from the server itself, values are shown as they are returned.
  • Nothing leaves your machine: the query goes to the server you configured, and nowhere else.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
First version.

  • Connection panel: host, port, user, password, default database.
  • SQL editor and a table showing the result of the last query.
  • Reads the official ClickHouse HTTP interface; JSON and TSV answers are both supported.
